instructions.text: Verification must be done using a standard reference thermometer or master thermometer calibrated by a SANAS accredited authority.
instructions.label: Verify thermometer accuracy

instructions.text: Place the probes in one container filled with water and allow the thermometer to read for 2 minutes, then record the findings.
instructions.label: How to establish correction factors

instructions.text: Readings should not exceed a difference of 0.5°C. If exceeded, report the thermometer and add the correction factor.
instructions.label: Tolerance
